# User Profile Storage

User profile storage is the part of an AI agentΓÇÖs memory that holds stable facts about each user, such as name, age group, language, past choices, and long-term goals. The agent saves this data in a file or small database so it can load it each time the same user returns. By keeping the profile separate from short-term conversation logs, the agent can remember preferences without mixing them with temporary chat history. The profile is updated only when the user states a new lasting preference or when old information changes, which helps prevent drift or bloat.
